title: What is PostgreSQL?
description: Learn what PostgreSQL is, its history, and why it is widely used.

data.text: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 30 years of active development.
It has earned a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance. PostgreSQL supports both SQL and JSON querying.

cards.title: ACID Compliant
cards.description: Full ACID compliance with multi-version concurrency control.

cards.title: Extensible
cards.description: Support for custom types, indexes, languages, and extensions.

cards.title: SQL & NoSQL
cards.description: Relational model plus JSONB for document-style data.

data.caption: PostgreSQL fits into application architecture.
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[Application] --> B[PostgreSQL]

    C --> D[PostGIS / pgvector / TimescaleDB]

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: PostgreSQL is open source and ACID compliant.
Extensions add spatial, time-series, and vector capabilities.
